name: ALLPCB
notes: https://www.allpcb.com/pcb_capabilities.html redirects to the home page; the standard and advanced capability pages were used. Standard: min 4/4 mil but 'strongly suggest to design trace above 6mil (0.15mm) to save cost'. Solder mask bridge 0.1 mm on request ('price may rise'). Advanced page: 3/3 mil (1 oz), 5.5/5.5 mil (2 oz), multilayer via 0.15/0.25 mm. NOTE: on 2026-10-07 the ALLPCB site shows a notice that it 'will temporarily suspend operations' (corporate governance adjustment).

value_notes.via_drill: Standard page: 'Drilling Size 0.2--6.5mm'. Advanced page: 'Preferred Min. Via hole size: 0.2mm'.
value_notes.via_annular_ring: Standard page says 'Annular Ring >=0.153mm (6mil)'; advanced page via 0.2/0.5 gives 0.15 mm, used for consistency.
value_notes.pth_annular_ring: Advanced page: 'Width of solder ring for plated DIP holes (1OZ) >=0.2mm (recommended value), the limit value is 0.18mm'.
value_notes.npth_drill: Drilling size 0.2-6.5 mm (not split by plating).
value_notes.max_drill: 'For vias larger than 6.5mm, multiple drilling or milling is recommended'. Max PTH round hole 8 mm.
value_notes.hole_to_hole: 'Via Space (Different Net) >=17mil'; same net >=8 mil; 'Min Space for Component Vias in Different Net >=24mil'. Edge vs centre not stated.
value_notes.edge_clearance: 'Distance between Trace and Outline >=0.3mm (12mil)'; to a V-cut line >=0.4 mm.
value_notes.silk_to_pad: Advanced page: 'Spacing from character to exposed copper pads >=0.15mm'.
value_notes.mask_bridge: Standard page: 'SolderMaskBridge 0.1mm - Please make a note, if there is solder mask bridge requirement. The price may rise.'
value_notes.plated_slot_width: Standard page 'Min Slot Width 0.6mm' (advanced page says plated slot >=0.7 mm; conflicting).
value_notes.castellated_hole: Standard page: 'Minimum Half hole Diameter: 1mm, No more than 10 holes.'
value_notes.smd_pad_to_pad: Not published (pad edge to trace edge >= 0.1 mm on the advanced page).
value_notes.track_width: 'Min Trace 4mil (0.1mm) - strongly suggest to design trace above 6mil (0.15mm) to save cost'.
